heroTitle: Your hair, seen in a new light
heroText: We listen to what you want and create a modern, flattering result that is easy to maintain every day.
studioTitle: Before we begin, we want to get to know you
studioText: Every head of hair, face and routine is different. We start by discussing your taste, how much time you spend styling and how you want to feel when you leave the salon.
servicesTitle: Everything begins with a good consultation
servicesIntro: Services adapted to your style, your hair and the result you want to achieve.
s1Text: Women's, men's and unisex cuts designed to flatter and work in everyday life.
s2Text: Colour, toning, highlights and lightening techniques adapted to your skin tone and preferred upkeep.
s3Text: Hydration, nourishment and repair protocols suited to the needs of your hair and scalp.
s4Text: Updos, waves and finishes for celebrations, photo sessions and special occasions.
priceNote: Indicative fictional prices for this demonstration website.
methodTitle: A beautiful result should also feel like you
step1Text: We discuss your ideas, habits and expectations.
step2Text: We consider texture, condition, colour and realistic possibilities.
step3Text: We work precisely while respecting the hair.
step4Text: We explain how to maintain and style the result at home.
looksText: A visual selection showing the range of techniques and finishes the salon can offer.
q1: Do I need to book in advance?
a1: We recommend it so we can allow enough time for you. Message us with the service and your preferred times.
q2: Do you assess the hair before colouring?
a2: Yes. We check its condition, colour history and your goal before confirming the technique and price.
q3: How long does an appointment take?
a3: It depends on the service, length and technique. We will give you an estimated time when booking.
a4: We select professional products according to the hair type and service performed.
contactTitle: Book your moment at Aura Cobre
contactText: Tell us which service interests you and your preferred time. We will reply to confirm availability.
demoNote: Fictional name, address and contact details for this demonstration website.

mwTitle: A professional website can show your style before the first appointment
mwText: AURA COBRE is a demonstration website. MesterWeb creates personalised websites for hair salons, barbers and beauty professionals, adapted to their services, images, opening hours and identity.
footerText: Cut, colour and care with a personal approach.
